findings.message:
[P2] Make terminal mapping retirement durable

When `getKv()` returns null or `kv.delete(...)` rejects, this function silently resolves without removing the key. The 404/410 branch has already accepted the downstream WebSocket and closes it as 1011, so once KV recovers a reconnect still reads the one-hour mapping, accepts another 101, and repeats the generic close instead of receiving terminal 404; retry or persist the retirement before allowing reconnects.

src/live/upstream.ts:165-168

summary: Terminal mappings are retired only on successful KV deletion; failures leave the reconnect loop intact.

evidence: The 404/410 unexpected-response branch invokes retireLiveCallMapping before closing the client bridge.
On a successful KV deletion, later joins find no mapping and receive the existing pre-upgrade 404 response, stopping reconnects.
